verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel is an immigration law firm, and a client portal or case-status dashboard is a fair question for this kind of service, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows consultation booking, 'guiding clients through every step', blogs and a newsletter. None of these is a documented portal or dashboard showing case status and next steps.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see where my case is — a client portal or dashboard with case status and next steps is a documented part of the product
